_: Shared editorial for all ten hats. Merged UNDER each hat's own file, which overrides any key it sets.
_specs: Five-panel and snapback are visible in the product photography. Nothing else about construction is published anywhere verifiable — no fabric, no closure detail, no sizing — so the fit block says so rather than guessing.
_note: Hats have zero variant axes, so the buy box renders no pickers. They are the simplest thing in the catalogue and the pages are deliberately short.

four.v: One size, adjusts at the back
The same as every other hat we make

marquee: Sold direct, never through a middleman
sizeHeadline: One size, and it actually is
sizeSub: Five-panel with a structured front and a snapback closure. It adjusts at the back and it holds its shape through a wet round and a hot car, which is more than most hats manage.
sizeNote: Hat measurements are not published anywhere we can verify, so they are left visibly empty rather than guessed at. A snapback fits nearly everyone, which is why this matters less here than it does on the polos — but it is still a real gap.
fitParas: Snapback, so the back adjusts through the usual range and one size genuinely does cover most heads.
The front is structured rather than soft, which is what keeps the panel flat and the graphic readable instead of creasing across the middle by the back nine.
closeBody: $29, one size, five-panel snapback. Thirty days to send it back unworn if it isn't you.
